summary: Former Giles County lookout on Potts Mountain near the Appalachian Trail; the visit page reports an overgrown trail to the site and includes a photo of one of the footings.

facts.status_note: Former lookout site. The old trail up to it is abandoned and overgrown.

visit.trail_note: The page gives an access detour of 0.1 mile off the Appalachian Trail. The old Potts Mountain Trail up to the site is overgrown, and the author could not locate it.

events.note: A map label reading Stony Creek Lookout Tower began appearing in 1965. This dates the name on the map, not the tower's construction.

evidence.quote: This label on the map started appearing in 1965.

notes_for_editor: Only two sources: an undated personal visit page and the FFLA county list. Searches found no build date, builder, staffing or removal date. The visit page warns that nearly everything the author found refers to a Craig County lookout, so check the site identity before relying on any other record. The FFLA unconfirmed list flags Giles Big Stony (same as Stony Creek?) as a possible duplicate. The land's public or private status is not stated. The FFLA point 37.41566, -80.51283 is not checked against the site. Fact-check 2026-10-21: the author could not locate the old trail, and the footing photo is not described as the author's own, so the story no longer says the author found the trail or took the photo.
